title: Student Protests Trigger End of One-Party Communist Rule
note: December 1990 student protests at University of Tirana confirmed. Party of Labour legalized opposition on 11 December 1990. 46-year figure correct (since 1944).

title: First Multi-Party Elections Held After Decades of Communism
note: Elections held 31 March 1991 confirmed. Communist Party of Labour retained power with rural support confirmed. Minor note: assembly had 250 seats not specified in event.

title: Mass Exodus to Italy as Thousands Flee Economic Collapse
note: Two waves confirmed: ~25,700 in March and ~20,000 in August 1991 (Vlora ship). 'Tens of thousands' figure is accurate. Both March and August crossings confirmed.

title: Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Dismantles Collective Farms
note: Land reform distributing collective farmland in 1991 is documented. Fragmentation of holdings confirmed.

title: Democratic Party Wins Landslide; Berisha Elected President
note: DP won 92 of 140 seats confirmed. Vote share was 62.3% (event says '62%' — acceptable rounding). Berisha elected president 9 April 1992 confirmed. '53 years' figure correct.

title: Shock Therapy Economic Reforms and Mass Privatization Begin
note: Rapid economic liberalization by the new Democratic Party government in 1992 confirmed. IMF assistance and price deregulation documented.

title: Constitutional Referendum Rejected by Voters
note: Referendum held 7 November 1994, rejected. Event says '54% of voters' against; actual figure was 56.4% against (43.6% in favour). Minor discrepancy but directionally correct.

title: Albania Joins NATO Partnership for Peace Program
note: Albania signed Partnership for Peace on 23 February 1994 confirmed. Description of it as 'one of the first post-communist states' is broadly accurate. 15-year path to NATO membership correct (1994–2009).

title: Contested Parliamentary Elections Marred by Fraud Allegations
note: May 1996 elections condemned by international observers and boycotted by opposition in second round confirmed.

title: Pyramid Scheme Collapse Triggers Nationwide Civil Unrest
note: Collapse started January 1997 confirmed. $1.2 billion face value of liabilities confirmed. Two-thirds of population as investors confirmed. Over 2,000 deaths confirmed. Event says 'January 1997' for collapse trigger — accurate.

title: UN-Authorized Operation Alba Restores Order
note: UN Security Council Resolution 1101 confirmed. Italy-led confirmed. Total deployment was 7,265 troops (event says '7,000 troops' — acceptable approximation). March 1997 deployment confirmed.

title: Socialist Party Wins Snap Elections; Berisha Forced to Resign
note: June 1997 elections won by Socialist Party under Fatos Nano confirmed. Berisha's resignation confirmed.

title: New Constitution Adopted by Referendum
note: Referendum on 22 November 1998 confirmed. Approved by 93.5% of voters with 50.6% turnout. Came into force 28 November 1998.

title: Assassination of Opposition MP Azem Hajdari Triggers Violence
note: Assassination on 12 September 1998 in Tirana confirmed. Berisha supporters stormed government buildings confirmed. Hajdari was a DP MP confirmed.

title: Albania Absorbs 450,000 Kosovo Refugees During NATO Campaign
note: UNHCR figures range from ~435,000 to ~442,000; event states 450,000 — slight overstatement but within range of peak estimates. '14%' population increase is plausible given Albania population ~3M.

title: Albania Provides Logistical Support for NATO Kosovo Operations
note: Albania's role as staging area for NATO Kosovo operations confirmed.

title: Local Government Elections Test Decentralization Reforms
note: October 2000 local elections held under new constitutional framework confirmed.

title: SAA Negotiations with EU Formally Launched
note: Albania started SAA negotiations in 2003 confirmed. SAA signed June 2006, in force April 2009.

title: Albania Begins Membership Action Plan with NATO
note: MAP was granted at the 1999 Washington Summit, not 2003. Event description acknowledges '1999' in the body but is filed under year 2003, which is misleading and factually wrong for the MAP start date. Year off by 4 years = FALSE.

title: Berisha Returns as Prime Minister After Democratic Party Victory
note: DP won July 2005 elections, Berisha became PM confirmed. Eight years since 1997 pyramid crisis is accurate.

title: Stabilisation and Association Agreement with EU Enters Force
note: SAA signed 12 June 2006 confirmed. Entered into force 1 April 2009 confirmed. Event year 2006 refers to the signing date, which is correct.

title: Albania Recognizes Kosovo Independence
note: Kosovo declared independence 17 February 2008. Albania among first to recognize, confirmed.

title: Albania Joins NATO as Full Member
note: Albania became NATO member on 1 April 2009 alongside Croatia confirmed.

title: Albania Submits Formal Application for EU Membership
note: Albania applied for EU membership on 28 April 2009 confirmed.

title: Disputed 2009 Elections Trigger Political Deadlock
note: June 2009 elections, narrow DP victory, Socialist boycott and prolonged deadlock confirmed.

title: Deadly Anti-Government Protests in Tirana
note: 21 January 2011 protests, Republican Guard opened fire, four killed confirmed.

title: Edi Rama Becomes Prime Minister After Socialist Victory
note: June 2013 election, Socialist-led Alliance for a European Albania won, Rama became PM confirmed.

title: Albania Granted EU Candidate Status
note: EU candidate status granted 23-24 June 2014 confirmed (General Affairs Council 24 June, endorsed by European Council shortly after). Event says '23 June' — the Council decision was 24 June; minor one-day discrepancy, VERIFIED.

title: Comprehensive Territorial and Administrative Reform Enacted
note: Parliament passed law 115/2014 on 31 July 2014 reducing municipalities from 373 (or 384 total LGUs) to 61 confirmed. Event says 'from 373 to 61' — matches one variant of the source figures.

title: Landmark Justice Reform Amends 46 Constitutional Articles
note: Parliament adopted reform on 22 July 2016, amending 46 constitutional articles confirmed. Vote was unanimous confirmed. '25 years' most radical overhaul confirmed.

title: Vetting Process Begins Dismissing Corrupt Judges and Prosecutors
note: Vetting became operational in 2017, majority of reviewed judges dismissed or resigned confirmed.

title: Rama Re-elected as Socialist Party Wins Second Term
note: June 2017, Socialist Party commanding majority, Rama second term confirmed.

title: Constitutional Court Becomes Non-Functional Due to Vetting Dismissals
note: Constitutional Court lost quorum from 2017 due to vetting dismissals confirmed.

title: Albania-Greece Maritime Border Agreement and Name Dispute Progress
note: Albania-Greece maritime boundary negotiations in 2018 confirmed. Connection to Prespa Agreement context is accurate.

title: Opposition Boycotts Parliament and Surrenders Mandates
note: DP MPs surrendered mandates February 2019 and boycotted parliament confirmed.

title: Magnitude 6.4 Earthquake Devastates Durres and Thumane
note: 26 November 2019, magnitude 6.4, 51 killed, ~3,000 injured confirmed. '1 billion euros in damage' is consistent with reported figures. 'Deadliest in 99 years' confirmed.

title: EU Decides to Open Accession Negotiations with Albania
note: EU Council decided in March 2020 to open accession negotiations confirmed. Formal negotiations opened July 2022.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic Prompts State of Natural Disaster Declaration
note: Albania declared state of natural disaster March 2020 due to COVID-19 confirmed.

title: Rama Wins Historic Third Term with Parliamentary Supermajority
note: April 2021, Socialist Party won 74 of 140 seats, Rama's third consecutive term confirmed. '74 seats' is not a supermajority (requires 94/140); the event's 'supermajority' label is inaccurate but the factual seat count and third-term claim are correct.

title: US Designates Berisha as Persona Non Grata for Corruption
note: US State Department designated Berisha and family persona non grata on 19 May 2021 citing significant corruption confirmed.

title: First EU Accession Conference Opens Formal Negotiations
note: First intergovernmental accession conference held 19 July 2022 confirmed. Procedural link to North Macedonia confirmed.

title: Tirana Hosts EU-Western Balkans Summit
note: Summit held 6 December 2022 in Tirana confirmed. First time held in a Western Balkan country confirmed.

title: Berisha Placed Under House Arrest on Corruption Charges
note: House arrest ordered 30 December 2023 confirmed. Communication restricted to household members confirmed. 5.4 million euro figure confirmed. Son-in-law Jamarber Malltezi confirmed.

title: Albania Opens Cluster 4 EU Negotiating Chapters
note: Cluster 4 (Green Agenda and Sustainable Connectivity) was opened on 16 September 2025, not in 2024. Cluster 1 (Fundamentals) opened 15 October 2024. Year is off by 1 year = FALSE.

title: Albania Opens Final EU Negotiating Cluster
note: Cluster 5 (Resources, Agriculture, Cohesion) opened 17 November 2025 confirmed. All clusters opened confirmed.
